description: Issue #286: walks follow check siblings, and absent reads fail despite negation or disjunction.
grammar:
%rule text a [empty] b
%rule a "a"
%rule b "b"
%rule empty ε
%check root
 #·text
%conditions ¬$.parent
%warning "root"
%check first
 #·a
%conditions $.parent ≅ #·text, ¬$.preceding-node, $.following-node ≅ #·b, $.following-node.split($) = "b".split("a")
%warning "first"
%check absent
 #·a
%conditions ¬($.preceding-node.value = "x")
%warning "bad"
%check disjunction
 #·a
%conditions $.preceding-node.value = "x" ∨ "a" = "a"
%warning "bad"
%check short
 #·a
%conditions "a" = "a" ∨ $.preceding-node.value = "x"
%warning "short"
